data.title: Train Yard: Freight and Passenger Jobs
data.description: Build different trains to carry people and goods safely over steep hills.

challenges.title: Morning Commuter Run
challenges.instruction: Build a train to move 2,710 commuters from suburb station to city terminal. The route climbs Oak Ridge, a 0.5% grade. Use the fewest cars and engines that get the whole load there.

challenges.title: Harvest Grain Haul
challenges.instruction: Build a train to move 770 tons of grain from prairie farm to river port. The route climbs Sunset Grade, a 3.0% grade. Use the fewest cars and engines that get the whole load there.

challenges.title: Milk Tanker Express
challenges.instruction: Build a train to move 1,390 tons of milk from dairy valley to metro dairy. The route climbs Blue Mountain, a 3.0% grade. Use the fewest cars and engines that get the whole load there.

challenges.title: Sawmill Timber Run
challenges.instruction: Build a train to move 1,630 tons of lumber from pine forest to city lumberyard. The route climbs Pine Pass, a 2.0% grade. Use the fewest cars and engines that get the whole load there.
